title: How to Work with JSON in Business Central’s AL Code
summary: Working with JSON in Business Central AL involves understanding JSON structures (values, objects, arrays) and using JsonObject, JsonArray, and JsonToken types to parse incoming JSON data and export records as JSON. This is essential for API integrations, AI systems, and computer-to-computer data exchanges.
key_points: JSON is built from values (name and value pairs), objects (containers of values and arrays) and arrays (lists of objects or values)
Parse incoming text with JsonObject.ReadFrom and read fields with GetText, GetInteger and GetArray
Iterate arrays with foreach over JsonToken, converting each token to a JsonObject
Export records by building JsonObject and JsonArray structures, then WriteTo text and download via a Temp Blob stream
The author notes REST APIs with JSON are simpler and leaner than SOAP APIs with XML

quotes.text: REST APIs use JSON and are generally simpler, human readable, and leaner.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why JSON is the standard for modern API communication in Business Central

quotes.text: Working with JSON data is critically important as we progress into more complex AI and data integration systems.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the strategic importance of JSON skills for developers building AI and integration solutions
